items.Sentence: The gravity collection system is designed to convey wastewater to a 19,200-gallon septic tank battery, which is comprised of twelve 1,600-gallon septic tanks arranged in three parallel trains.
The wastewater treatment system is comprised of a gravity collection system, a septic tank battery, and disposal leachfields.
The septage is hauled to the District's Deer Creek Wastewater Treatment Plant, which is regulated under National Pollutant Discharge Elimination System (NPDES) Order R5-2014-0081.
